name: com.whichaisent/ai-visibility
title: Which AI Sent: AI visibility check
description: Check if ChatGPT and Gemini recommend a business, and who they name instead. Free, no key.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Asks ChatGPT and Gemini (both with live web search) three questions a customer would ask, such as "What are the best movers in Dallas, TX?", and reports whether the given business is named, at what position, and which businesses are named instead. Use it when someone wants to know if AI assistants recommend their (or a client's) business. Takes about a minute. Results are a snapshot of one day; answers change. Free, with a shared daily limit.

service.description: What the business does, in the words a customer would use, e.g. "movers", "plumber", "dentist".

location.description: City and state or region the business serves, e.g. "Dallas, TX". Recommended for local businesses.
